concept: Alaska got written into America's AI moonshot and nobody noticed. A national AI programme put Alaska's power grid on its award list, the entire public record is one line, and the reason Alaska makes sense is knowable even though the abstract is not.
palette: document-black and filament-amber, one live teal, unlit rows in true black

angle.thesis: A national AI initiative reached down and put Alaska's power grid on its list, and the one-line public record is not a scandal, it is an invitation to look at why Alaska is the right place to test grid AI.
supporting: DOE Genesis Mission Phase I awards list posted 2026-07-22 carries AURORA-AI, University of Alaska Fairbanks, PI Richard Wies, verbatim from the OSTI PDF
No Alaska outlet and not UAF itself has reported it as of 2026-07-29
The same department already spent $6.2M making Cordova's islanded microgrid a real-time model, so the choice of Alaska has precedent
angle.counter_point: The empty record may simply be normal Phase I administrative practice rather than anything withheld, and the film must not imply concealment. Cordova is a SEPARATE, EARLIER project and is labelled as such on screen.
runners_up: A transparency or accountability frame, rejected because award lists routinely lack abstracts at Phase I and the cynical read is not earned
Making Cordova the whole story, rejected because it is out of window and would bury the actual news

treatment.winner: THE EXPLAINER, grafted with the DRAMATIST's held turn
treatment.judge_reasoning: The Explainer wins because the piece's pleasure is a genuine recontextualisation of scale, one line inside two hundred, which is a picture rather than a claim. Grafted from the Dramatist: the turn is staged as a light going out on a character rather than as a narrated caveat, which keeps an administrative fact emotionally legible. Grafted from the Enthusiast: Cordova is played warm and proud rather than as a curiosity, so the why-Alaska stretch earns real admiration instead of pity.

fingerprint.palette: document-black and filament-amber, one live teal, unlit rows in true black
fingerprint.metaphor: one line of type in a two hundred row federal list, and the lumpy amber country that line is actually describing

hook.frame1: A single lamp-lit printed row on a dark federal award list, the words AURORA-AI legible at frame 0, 199 other rows falling away into unlit grey.
hook.headline: One line said Alaska
hook.loopback: The closing shot returns to the same lamp-lit line and asks what is inside it, so the last frame rhymes with the first.

reveals.what: the islanded grids ignite one at a time across a dark Alaska until the scatter itself is the argument
Cordova's teal wireframe twin draws itself vertex by vertex and then matches the real town's motion
THE SIGNATURE. Pull back from the readable AURORA-AI line until it is one hairline among 200 rows

divergence_note: Against 2026-07-26, which was a high-key blueprint-technical interior shot in exploded-diagram POV with an orbit-reveal camera descending through a single object in void, this is a low-key editorial-schematic world in macro-closeup POV on a hard modular grid, rising rather than descending, and lit almost entirely by emission rather than by a flat overhead key. Against 2026-07-25, which was an eye-level naturalistic fjord in stacked layers traversing horizontally under rationed tungsten, this trades the outdoor landscape for a printed document that becomes a map, swaps horizontal traverse for a vertical rise-reveal, and makes the hero a personified power plant rather than an instrument. The signature move, pulling back from one readable line to 200 rows, has never been used by this channel.

shots.camera: static:frame 1 must be a dead-legible printed line for the poster grade so every bit of motion comes from rows stamping into the page around it
shots.stage3d: flat:a sheet of paper lying under a lamp has no world to move through, and faking depth here would undercut the hard ruled grid the shape language depends on
shots.centered: the single printed row reading AURORA-AI, dead centre, lit by one lamp
shots.means: the whole film in one object, a fact sitting in the dark that nobody has read

hero.name: The award row
hero.detail_note: printed stock with real body via Sheet and PaperFiber, a 2px edge, drop shadow 4 down 2 right at 22 percent, hairline column rules, ruled row separators, and the row text set in mono so it reads as a record and not a caption

shots.centered: the Genesis Mission assembling itself as a lit structure, AI and supercomputing and quantum snapping together into one machine
shots.means: establishes the national scale that Alaska is one line inside of

hero.name: The Genesis machine
hero.detail_note: a built structure of stacked compute racks, a cooling spine, and a quantum bell jar, each with vents, indicator LEDs and cable runs, teal readouts on the faces, amber only where it draws power

shots.camera: static:the emptiest frame in the film is held on purpose so the loss of key light IS the motion and the turn registers as an absence
shots.centered: Sourdough alone in near-black, his furnace window dimming as the record proves empty
shots.means: the turn, drawn as a light going out rather than narrated as a caveat

hero.name: Sourdough
hero.detail_note: barrel body with rivet seams, furnace window chest as the emotional tell, stack cap, pressure gauge, footing plinth, all form-shaded with rim light and contact shadow, glow param driving the dim

shots.centered: amber points igniting one by one across a dark Alaska until the map is a scatter of separate lights
shots.means: hundreds of separate grids made physical, so islanded stops being a word and becomes a picture

hero.name: The scatter of islanded grids
hero.detail_note: true-geography Alaska landmass in near-black, individually igniting amber nodes each with a bloom and a hairline halo, no connecting lines anywhere because that absence IS the point

shots.centered: Cordova on the left in amber, its teal wireframe copy on the right, moving in lockstep one frame apart
shots.means: the digital twin explained by showing it, a copy that keeps up, with the SEPARATE PROJECT tag on screen

hero.name: Cordova and its live model
hero.detail_note: hydro dam with penstock curve and spillway, powerhouse with lit windows, Cell on sled runners with its charge-bar face, one resident figure, and the whole thing mirrored as a teal wireframe with vertex dots and scan sweep

shots.centered: THE SIGNATURE SHOT. Tight on the AURORA-AI line, then the camera pulls back and keeps pulling until it is one hairline stripe among 200 identical rows
shots.means: Alaska's entire presence in a national AI programme, drawn to true scale in one unbroken move

hero.name: The 200-row list
hero.detail_note: 200 ruled rows at true scale, 199 unlit and rendered as grey hairlines, one row lit amber and legible, column rules, a page edge with thickness, and a lamp pool that shrinks as the camera rises

shots.centered: Sourdough at ground level, furnace flaring back to full amber, the closing question set beside him
shots.means: loops back to the opening lamp-lit line, and hands the audience the open question

hero.name: Sourdough at the button
hero.detail_note: same rig as shot 3 with glow driven back up, contact shadow re-forming on the ground plane as light returns, breath and idle sway running so the held final figure is alive
